h1: Best LMS for Coaching Institutes in India (2026): 11 Options Ranked by Use Case
dek: There is no single best LMS for every institute. This guide ranks eleven options by what they do best, with each price taken from the official site and dated, so you can pick the one that fits how you teach.
cover_alt: Which LMS fits your coaching institute: eleven options ranked by use case, with prices checked on official sites on 24 Oct 2026
audience: Coaching institute owners and independent educators in India choosing a learning management system
intro: The best LMS for a coaching institute in India depends on how you teach and sell: Learnyst for test-heavy academies, Edmingle for training businesses, Classplus for a flat yearly price at higher sales, and AllCoaching for building your own branded website and app yourself. Exly and TagMango suit coaches selling sessions and communities, and Tutor LMS or LearnDash suit institutes already running WordPress.

We are AllCoaching, so read this knowing who wrote it. Every competitor price below comes from that company's own website, with the link and the date we checked it (24 Oct 2026), and we rank by use case rather than naming one winner, because no single platform is best for every institute.

When we checked these pricing pages, the biggest differences were not features. They were the shape of the bill (a fixed price, a percentage of sales, or both), which plan includes your own domain and app, and whether you can start yourself or must book a demo.
takeaways: Best for building your own brand yourself: AllCoaching, from ₹6,999 a year + 10% of sales (Growth ₹12,999 + 7.5%, Pro ₹24,999 + 5%), GST extra, with your own domain and Android and iOS app on every plan and a 14-day free trial.
Best for test-heavy academies: Learnyst, Launcher ₹10,000 a year + 10%, or 0%-fee plans from ₹8,099 a month billed annually; taxes extra.
Best for training businesses: Edmingle, from ₹7,499 a month billed annually, taxes extra; no fee on sales is stated.
Best for a flat yearly price: Classplus, ₹29,999 for 1 year; GST, sales fee and renewal price are not stated on its page.
Exly and TagMango have no upfront fee on their entry plans but take 10% commission; their higher plans cut the commission for a fixed fee.
Graphy, Teachmint and AppX: Graphy's rupee prices could not be confirmed on 24 Oct 2026; Teachmint and AppX list no prices.
WordPress plugins are priced in US dollars: Tutor LMS from $199 a year (free core) and LearnDash from $350; hosting, gateway and upkeep are extra.

sections.h2: How we compared LMS platforms for coaching institutes
sections.html:
We compared eleven platforms that Indian coaching institutes shortlist, on five points an owner pays for or depends on.

  1. Published price, taken only from each company's own pricing page.
  2. Fee on your sales, because a percentage changes the total as you grow.
  3. Own domain and own app: included, an add-on, or on a higher plan.
  4. How you start: self-serve sign-up or a demo and sales call.
  5. Who it is built for: test-series academies, training businesses, coaches, creators or schools.
Disclosure: AllCoaching publishes this guide. Competitor figures link to their official pages and carry the date we checked them (24 Oct 2026). US-dollar prices are shown as published and exclude Indian GST. Prices change; check the source before you decide. If you spot an error, write to contact@allcoaching.in and we will correct it.

sections.h2: What actually differs between LMS platforms
sections.html:
Almost every LMS on this list can host a course, run a test and take a payment. Four things separate them for a coaching institute.

1. The shape of the bill

Some charge a fixed yearly or monthly price (Classplus, Edmingle, Learnyst's higher plans). Some charge a percentage of sales with little or nothing upfront (Exly Starter, TagMango Basic). Some do both (AllCoaching, Learnyst Launcher). Which is cheaper depends on your sales, so convert every percentage into rupees at your own numbers.

2. Where your own domain and app sit

On some platforms your own domain and branded app are included; on others they are a higher plan or a paid add-on. Ask which plan, at what price, before you compare anything else.

{{q:Do I need an LMS or a coaching app?|Today most platforms are both: an LMS to run courses and tests, plus a website and an Android and iOS app for students. What matters is whether the app carries your name, who publishes it, and which plan includes it.}}

3. Rupees or dollars

Tutor LMS, LearnDash, Kajabi, Teachable and Thinkific price in US dollars. Your cost then moves with the exchange rate while your students pay in rupees, and GST is not included.

4. Self-serve or sales-led

Teachmint and AppX start with a demo. Others let you sign up and build. Neither is wrong, but a self-serve trial lets you test with real students before you pay.

{{fig:before-after|Before and after for a coaching institute: live classes on one app, fees on UPI screenshots, notes in Drive, doubts on WhatsApp and tests on Google Forms, compared with one academy login with your own website, app, live classes, checkout and tests|Whichever LMS you choose, the goal is one place for courses, students and payments.}}

1. AllCoaching: best for building your own brand yourself

Good at

Published price
Starter ₹6,999/yr + 10% on sales, Growth ₹12,999/yr + 7.5%, Pro ₹24,999/yr + 5%; GST extra.[1]
Free trial
14 days, no card needed.
Check
The percentage on sales adds up as you grow; above about ₹2.3 lakh a year a flat-price plan can cost less.
Best for
Institutes and tutors who want their own website and app, set up without a sales call.

NEET, JEE, SSC and banking academies where mock tests are the main product.

sections.h2: What each LMS really costs as you grow
sections.html:
A headline price tells half the story when a platform also takes a percentage. The chart adds each published plan price to its published fee at five sales levels and uses the lowest-cost plan each time.

{{fig:cost|Total yearly cost at ₹0 to ₹10 lakh of sales from published prices for AllCoaching, Exly, Classplus, Learnyst and Edmingle|Before GST. Classplus and Edmingle lines are listed prices only, because their pages do not state a fee on sales.}} {{cost_table}}

The honest reading: below ₹5 lakh of sales a year, Exly Starter and TagMango Basic cost the least on paper, because they charge no upfront fee and the same 10% as AllCoaching Starter, though their custom website and app are paid add-ons. AllCoaching costs less than Classplus up to ₹2.3 lakh a year, less than Edmingle Core up to about ₹13 lakh, and less than Learnyst's 0%-fee Professional plan (₹97,188 a year billed annually) up to about ₹14.4 lakh. Between ₹5 lakh and about ₹41.5 lakh it also costs less than Exly's best plan. We left Graphy out because we could not confirm its rupee prices, and the US-dollar platforms because their totals depend on the exchange rate.

sections.h2: Which LMS fits your coaching institute
sections.html:
New institute or solo tutor

Keep fixed costs low and start quickly. A self-serve trial lets you build and sell before you commit. Our guide on how to sell courses online in India covers the first sale.

Test-series academy (NEET, JEE, SSC, banking)

Look closely at test engines such as Learnyst, and compare with building tests inside your own academy. See how to create mock tests online.

Institute that wants its own brand

Check which plan includes your own domain and your own Android and iOS app. See LMS with a custom domain and what a white-label coaching app costs.

Training business with branches

Batch, branch and cohort tools matter more than price. Edmingle is built for this; AllCoaching includes multi-teacher institutes on every plan.

Institute already on WordPress

A plugin keeps you on your current site, but you run hosting, updates and payments yourself. Read cloud LMS vs self-hosted for coaching first.

faq: Which is the best LMS for a coaching institute in India in 2026?

It depends on your use case. Learnyst suits test-heavy academies, Edmingle suits training businesses, Classplus suits institutes wanting a flat yearly price at higher sales, and AllCoaching suits institutes that want to build their own branded website and app themselves, from ₹6,999 a year plus a fee on sales.
What does an LMS cost for a coaching institute in India?

On official pages checked 24 Oct 2026, entry prices range from no upfront fee with 10% commission (Exly Starter, TagMango Basic) to ₹6,999 a year plus 10% (AllCoaching), ₹10,000 a year plus 10% (Learnyst), ₹29,999 a year (Classplus) and ₹7,499 a month billed annually (Edmingle). Taxes are extra where stated.
Which LMS platforms charge a fee on sales?

AllCoaching (10%, 7.5% or 5%), Learnyst Launcher (10%), Exly (10%, 6% or 3%) and TagMango (10%, 5.5% or 3.5%, zero on Ultimate) publish a fee on sales. Learnyst's monthly plans list 0%. Classplus and Edmingle do not state a fee on their pricing pages.
Which LMS includes a custom domain and own app on its entry plan?

AllCoaching includes your own domain and your own Android and iOS app on every plan. On Learnyst and Edmingle, branded apps start on higher plans; on Exly and TagMango, custom domain and apps are paid add-ons.
Is a WordPress LMS like Tutor LMS or LearnDash good for a coaching institute?

It can be, if you already run WordPress and have someone to maintain it. Tutor LMS has a free core and Pro plans from $199 a year; LearnDash bundles start at $350. Hosting, payment gateway, app and upkeep are separate.
Is Moodle a good choice for a coaching institute?
Moodle is open-source software you host yourself, so it suits institutes with technical staff. We did not price its hosting for this guide; budget for hosting, setup and maintenance.
Which LMS is best for selling test series and mock tests?
Learnyst is built around test series and mock tests. You can also run chapter and full-length tests inside an AllCoaching academy alongside courses and live classes.
Will an LMS bring me more students?

Mostly no. An LMS runs your courses; finding students stays your job through YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp and search. AllCoaching also lists your courses on its marketplace app for discovery, but that supports your own marketing rather than replacing it.
